Definition: a Shuthalchite (collectively) or descendants of Shuthelach
BiblicalUsage: Shuthalchi is a Shuthalchite, a descendant of Shuthelah of Ephraim, named once in the census of the families. The sons of Ephraim are counted by their fathers' houses, and the Shuthalhites stand in their place among them.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the census counted every family because every family counted, and God loses none of His people in the count.
